info.title: envvault
info.description: Cross-platform keychain-backed env-var manager. Envchain-compatible plus a Windows backend.

options.name: --set
options.description: Store one or more KEYs in NAMESPACE. Values come from an interactive prompt (or --value for non-interactive; single key only when combined with --value).

options.name: --list
options.description: With no NAMESPACE, list all namespaces. With a NAMESPACE, list its keys.

options.name: --get
options.description: Print the value of KEY in NAMESPACE to stdout.

options.name: --allow-empty
options.description: Allow --set to store an empty string. By default envvault refuses empty values because silently storing "" is the exact footgun the tool exists to prevent (child command fails hours later with 'invalid credentials').

options.name: --noecho
options.description: Accepted for envchain compatibility (we never echo by default).

options.name: --require-passphrase
options.description: Defer decryption to a passphrase prompt. Accepted as a flag but not yet implemented — returns an error until v1.1.

options.name: --value
options.description: Explicit value for --set (alternative to stdin prompting). Be careful with shell history.

options.name: --describe
options.description:
Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
Exit Codes:
0    Success; in exec form, the child process's exit code is passed through
125  Usage error: bad flags, missing positionals, mutually-exclusive action flags, or deferred feature used (--require-passphrase)
126  Runtime error: key store unavailable, permission denied launching child command
127  Not found: namespace or key missing on --get/--unset; command for exec form not on PATH
